verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs claim support for 200+ HuggingFace model architectures, plus a Transformers modeling backend and trust_remote_code for further models. MoE is implied by expert parallelism and multi-LoRA for MoE layers, and community feedback corroborates a 'huge model library'. However, multi-modal and embedding model support are not explicitly documented in the pack. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-modal model support, explicit evidence of embedding/pooling model support, a documented supported-models breakdown by category.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
vLLM also supports model implementations that are available in Transformers. We call this feature the "Transformers modeling backend".
Efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers
Tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and context parallelism for distributed inference
a huge model library including low precision mattered more
